messages:
Asha Iyer: heads-up - Customer 'northstar-analytics' on Dedicated flagged a sudden surge of 429s and aborted streams starting ~02:10 UTC. They report large numbers of short concurrent streams to /v1/chat/generate. They believe nothing changed on their side.

Diego Marquez: can you paste one of the error payloads and headers? also which dedicated cluster and the limiter template version?

Asha Iyer: sample error:
```
{ \"error\": \"rate_limited\", \"message\": \"exceeded per-route capacity\", \"retry_after_seconds\": 30 }
```
sample headers: 
```
x-req-id: rq_b7a2
x-rate-limit-limit: 200
x-rate-limit-remaining: 0
x-rate-limit-reset: 167912
```
Cluster: ded-us-west-2-07, template tag deployed: limiter-template@4.1. Sender says bursty traffic from a controller service (many short lived streams).

Priya Nair: I see ALARM:RATELIM:3297 triggered at 02:11 UTC for ded-us-west-2-07. Token bucket depth for account northstar went to zero and stayed there for ~9 minutes despite sustained requests. Paging logs now.

bench-bot: CI deploy 7721 started by Diego Marquez 9-> packaging limiter-template@4.1 -> 4.2 to Dedicated clusters (in progress)

Diego Marquez: I pushed a packaging change earlier to normalize time units for burst windows. Locally I tested with synthetic bursts and it looked fine. Rolling now.

Asha Iyer: Support extracted packaging artifact and found burst_window config in the artifact is set to \"0.12\" (intended as seconds) while the runtime expects milliseconds. That lowers the effective burst allowance drastically.

Priya Nair: Confirmed. Packager erroneously converts float seconds to string and the runtime's parser treats it as ms, so 0.12 -> 0.12 ms equivalent (near zero). That explains the immediate exhaustion.

Diego Marquez: rolling rollback to limiter-template@4.1 now. Command used: 
```
kubectl set image configmap/limiter-templates limiter-template=limiter-template@4.1 -n redwood
```
Also pausing further packaging jobs until root cause identified.

bench-bot: Deployment 7721 rollback initiated by Diego Marquez - 8 clusters targeted

Priya Nair: after rollback, token refill graphs show recovery within two refill windows. Remaining tokens went from 0 -> expected. Customer reports streams resumed, some earlier requests timed out.

Asha Iyer: customer impact summary for support: approx 1.8k requests returned 429 between 02:10-02:19 UTC, some streaming sessions aborted. They want confirmation of fix, human-readable explanation, and ask whether billable attempts will be credited.

Diego Marquez: root cause: packager normalization function allowed fractional seconds string to slip through; runtime treats numeric string as milliseconds without validation. Fix: enforce integer ms in packager and hard-validate in runtime parser. I've opened PR-2209 for packager and PR-2210 for runtime protective checks.

Priya Nair: I've added a hotfix alert rule to detect per-account bucket drain time < configured_refill * 0.5 for > 2 minutes and notify oncall. Also adding a canary job to exercise limiter templates in staging with a short burst test.

Asha Iyer: drafting external note for the customer - please review: 
- what happened: a packaging/unit mismatch caused burst windows to be interpreted as near-zero, reducing allowed burst capacity and producing transient 429s;
- impact: 02:10-02:19 UTC, ~9 minutes of elevated 429s and some aborted streams;
- mitigation: rolled back template, tokens recovered and traffic normalized;
- next steps: packager + runtime validation fixes, CI canary, and we can discuss a credit for billable failures.

Diego Marquez: approve message. I'll link PRs and add timeline. Recommend offering a pro-rated credit and technical appendix for their SRE.

Priya Nair: operational action items:
1) merge PR-2209 (packager strict ms enforce) + unit tests - Diego
2) merge PR-2210 (runtime guard reject ms < 50) - Diego
3) add canary limiter smoke test in CI that runs prior to Dedicated rollout - Priya
4) dashboard to show configured vs observed burst_window per-account - metrics team

Asha Iyer: assigning follow-ups and opening INC-2026-411. I'll send the approved customer message and coordinate credit decision with billing.

support-team: customer update posted. They appreciated quick rollback and asked for postmortem. (reaction :white_check_mark:)

bench-bot: Incident INC-2026-411 created by Asha Iyer.

Diego Marquez: retro note - don't assume runtime tolerates fractional units. Add explicit schema validation in packaging pipeline. Also add a brief rollout pause for Dedicated template changes to verify on a single cluster.

Priya Nair: closing thread for now. Reopen if we see repeat 429s from northstar or other customers after next rollout.

support-team: resolved for now. (reaction :lock:)
